description: This file defines the EventHubQueueCache class, which implements a cache for EventHub data streams within the Orleans framework. It manages caching, purging, pressure monitoring, and cursor management for EventHub messages.

classes.name: EventHubQueueCache
classes.description: Implements a cache for EventHub stream data, managing message storage, purging, pressure monitoring, and cursor handling within Orleans.

methods.name: SignalPurge
methods.description: Triggers a purge of the cache via the eviction strategy.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Adds a cache pressure monitor to the cache's back pressure algorithm.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, particularly unregistering purge callbacks.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items that can be added to the cache, considering current pressure.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a list of EventData messages to the cache, returning their stream positions.

methods.name: GetCursor
methods.description: Retrieves a cursor object for reading from a specific stream and sequence token.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the next message from the cache for a given cursor, updating cache pressure metrics.

methods.name: OnPurge
methods.description: Handles cache purge events, updating the checkpointer with the last purged message offset.

methods.name: TryCalculateCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Calculates how close a message is to being purged, returning a value between 0 and 1.

methods.name: GetSegment
methods.description: Allocates a memory segment for message storage, requesting new buffers as needed.
